title: Playground
body: This is the playground: a free-exploration mode with no tasks and no questionnaire. Two portfolio strategies are loaded as Pareto frontiers: equity heavy and fixed income/cash heavy. Use the Frontiers panel to toggle them, switch between chart types in both spaces, and select, filter and compare solutions freely. Open the Chart Guide at any time for a reminder of how each chart works. DISCLAIMER: All data is entirely synthetic and should not be taken as investment advice.
